narrationTexts: Two real bugs, both caused by the dependency bump changing shapes the code wasn't updated for.
finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

- [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) treated an unset flag as invalid. New config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest was ~950 lines of deprecation noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc), not worth acting on.

Next: nothing.
